subject: Request: one-time pilot credit top-up & trial window extension for Olive AI
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: one-time pilot credit top-up & trial window extension for Olive AI

Hi Laura / Karthik —

Quick escalation: Olive AI (contact: Jennifer Park) is stalled in procurement due to an internal security review that pushed their PO timeline ~3 weeks. They’re a high-propensity win (analytics + clinical workflow use case) and we’re at the demo -> pilot commitment stage. CS asks for an extra 250k tokens of free pilot credits and a 21-day trial extension beyond our standard PLG cap to keep momentum and validate throughput using their 8k context model.

Why ask: they’re deep in the technical evaluation and agreed to an integration plan, but procurement won’t sign until their legal finalizes the DPA. If we don’t provide a small makegood/top-up and extend the trial, they will punt evaluation and likely re-run competitive bake-offs. Expected mid-year ARR: $240k first-year.

What I’m requesting (one-time, non-recurring):
- Pilot credit top-up: 250,000 tokens (applied to the existing trial project)
- Trial window extension: +21 days from the current trial expiry
- Condition: Olive AI signs the PO within 30 days of extension OR agrees to a refundable commitment if they don’t (we can convert to a pre-paid trial invoice).

Supporting artifacts attached: Mutual Action Plan v3, pilot schedule, CS summary. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/2381

Ask: approval to grant the top-up + extension and permission to offer the temporary refundable term if needed. If you want a small credit cap instead of tokens, I can convert to $ value.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

[Attachments: OliveAI_MutualActionPlan_v3.pdf (pdf), proposed-pilot-schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet), cs-pilot-summary-2027-10-01.pdf (pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time pilot credit top-up & trial window extension for Olive AI

Vivek —

Thanks for the concise note and the attachments. I agree we should prioritize high-propensity deals where procurement timing, not product fit, is the blocker. Two quick clarifications before I sign off:

1) Is the 250k tokens roughly equivalent to $1.5k in usage? Confirm the dollar conversion and call it out in the request so Finance can see the P&L impact.
2) The refundable commitment sounds reasonable, but we need the legal/finance language. Can CS draft a short clause: "Top-up refundable if PO not provided within 30 days; refund cap = full credit amount."

If those two items are green, I’m okay to approve a one-time exception. Karthik — do you want this routed through Deal Desk (discount/non-standard terms) or can I approve directly and you operationalize?

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference

Laura / Vivek —

I reviewed the CTL & expected ARR. A few operational notes:

- 250k tokens converted to our billing approx = $1,600 (based on standard hosted rates).
- Approve: one-time pilot credit top-up of 250k tokens and 21-day extension, conditional on a signed refundable commitment as described.
- Non-standard terms: since this is outside PLG caps, Deal Desk needs to create a short amendment (one paragraph) to the trial terms and add a note in HubSpot that this is a one-off exception. I can log the Deal Desk approval if Laura confirms.
- Finance: please confirm P&L impact and that refundable credit flows into the "trial reserves" bucket; Markus, can you confirm?

Operational ask for Sales to external: provide the refundable clause language and include a link to the PO template we’ll accept. Once Olive agrees to the clause, we process the top-up and extend the trial.

Subject: Olive AI — approved one-time pilot credit & extension (next steps)

Jennifer / Samir —

Good news: Redwood can approve a one-time pilot credit top-up of 250,000 tokens and a 21-day extension of your trial window. This is a limited, non-recurring exception tied to DEAL-2381. To finalize:

1) Please confirm via email that Olive AI will either sign the PO within 30 days of the extension or accept the refundable credit clause below.

Refundable clause (sample):
"Redwood will apply a one-time pilot credit of 250,000 tokens to Olive AI's trial project. If Olive AI does not execute a purchase order for Redwood's services within 30 days of the extended trial expiry, Olive AI is eligible for a refund of the pilot credit in full upon request. Refunds will be processed after a 15-day review window and will be capped at the original credited amount."

2) Procurement: once Jennifer confirms, we will provision the token top-up and extend the trial. I’ve shared the PO template link and the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/2381.

3) Next steps for Redwood legal/finance: Karthik — please add the amendment to the Deal Desk record. Markus — tagging you to confirm "trial reserves" handling.

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Vivek will follow up with a DocuSign for the amendment link once both sides confirm.

Best —
